description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From Lexington, KY
New in the Original Packaging
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Complete Brake Hose Replacement Set.
Comes with BOTH Front Brake Hoses and BOTH Rear Brake Hoses.
Direct Replacement for Years 1986 thru 1988
I also carry the the Brake Hose Set for years 1988.5 thru 1995 in my eBay Store!
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Front Brake Hoses (Fits LH side & RH side)
Qty 2 – Rear Brake Hoses (Fits LH side & RH side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
